**Dq ≈ 1590 cm⁻¹, B ≈ 780 cm⁻¹ (C ≈ 3510 cm⁻¹ from C = 4.5B)**

I fitted the three bands with the d⁶ low-spin fit tool. The tool needs an absolute C value, so I could not give it C/B = 4.5 directly. I fitted at fixed C values and then adjusted by hand until C = 4.5B held.

The bands are assigned as ¹A₁g → ¹T₁g, ¹A₁g → ¹T₂g and ¹A₁g → ¹T₂g(b), which is the second ¹T₂g level.

| Fixed C (cm⁻¹) | Fitted Dq (cm⁻¹) | Fitted B (cm⁻¹) | C/B |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2700 | 1551 | 764 | 3.5 |
| 3150 | 1574 | 773 | 4.1 |

Between these two fits, B changes by about 0.021 cm⁻¹ per cm⁻¹ of C, and Dq by about 0.05 cm⁻¹ per cm⁻¹ of C. I extrapolated this slope to the point where C = 4.5B. That gives B ≈ 781 cm⁻¹, C ≈ 3510 cm⁻¹ and Dq ≈ 1592 cm⁻¹. I did not run the tool at that final point. The fit residuals at the two fixed-C points were about 10 cm⁻¹ or less per band.
